land_pattern.notes: From Fig 11-1 (p38, read visually; unit mm): 48 edge pads 0.4 wide x 0.8 long; 4 corner pads (50-53) 0.7 x 0.7; central EPAD (pin 49, GND) is a 3x3 array of 1.45 x 1.45 square pads with 0.6 gaps (5.4 x 5.4 total, thermal vias shown; pin-1 corner chamfered). Pad-row extents: 11.9 / 11.8 across the bottom/top rows, 9.9 / 9.8 and 11.2 along side columns, 1.6 dimension at pad rows, 0.8 pad length. Overall land+antenna area 13.2 wide x 16.6 tall, of which antenna area is 13.2 x 5.4 (16.6 - 11.2) at the top, plus 0.8 below the pad rows. Pin numbering (Fig 3-1 top view, p10): pins 1-11 left column top to bottom, 12-24 bottom row left to right, 25-35 right column bottom to top, 36-48 top row right to left, 49 center, 50 top-right, 51 bottom-right, 52 bottom-left, 53 top-left corner. Pad pitch is not dimensioned in the figure text; take from the STEP/source file (see OPEN).
